title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Rice Owls and Arkansas State Red Wolves, originally scheduled for Sunday, November 29, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Rice Owls win, the market will resolve to "Rice Owls".
If the Arkansas State Red Wolves win, the market will resolve to "Arkansas State Red Wolves".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
